guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice shows the largest and earliest anomaly (latency-50 z=+714, socket count 5 -> 47.7, z=+170), and its callers recommendationservice and frontend degrade after it, consistent with the service map. CPU (+418%) and memory (+236%) also rose, but the socket count rose the most and the CPU/memory increases are plausibly secondary to connection buildup; logs contain no warnings or errors, so the fault type is inferred from metrics alone.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect productcatalogservice open connections and connection pool/limits, then restart or scale out its pods to clear the connection buildup. Verify connection handling and add connection limits or timeouts.
